Synopsis:
Opinion piece by Robert Reich urging Democratic candidates to frame the 2026 US midterm elections around economic hardship under Trump. Key themes: tariff-driven household cost increases, a US-Iran war disrupting the Strait of Hormuz and pushing up energy/food prices, cuts to Medicaid/Medicare, corporate profit boom vs. Main Street stagnation, and declining consumer sentiment. Explicitly partisan in framing, directed at a US domestic political audience.
